name: Owl - Pirate Lookout
en:
WELL SPOTTED During your turn, whenever a card
is put into your inkwell, chosen opposing character
gets -1 ¤ until the start of your next turn.

if this card is in your discard, you may play her

name: Chip - Friend Indeed

DALE'S PARTNER When you play this character,
chosen character gets +1 ◊ this turn.

a card is put into your inkwell, you may reveal
the top card of your deck. If it's an item card, you
may play that item for free and they enter play
exerted. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your
deck.
zh: 有利機會　在你的回合中，每當有卡被放入你的墨水池時，你可以展示你牌庫頂的卡。若它是物品卡，你可以免費打出該物品且它橫置進場；否則，將它放到你牌庫底。

zh: Chip 的搭檔　除非你有一個名為 Chip 的角色在場，否則這個角色橫置進場。

name: David - Impressive Surfer

SHOWING OFF While you have a character named
Nani in play, this character gets +2 ◊.
zh: 炫耀　當你有一個名為 Nani 的角色在場時，這個角色獲得 +2 ◊。

Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Stitch.)
READY FOR ACTION When you play this character,
if you used Shift to play him, you may put an action
card from your discard on the top of your deck.

變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Stitch 的角色上。）

記住你的訓練　當你打出這個角色時，你的角色本回合獲得 +2 ¤。

name: Baymax - Armored Companion
en:
THE TREATMENT IS WORKING When you play this
character and whenever he quests, you may remove up
to 2 damage from another chosen character of yours.
Gain 1 lore for each 1 damage removed this way.
zh: 治療起效了　當你打出這個角色以及每當他探險時，你可以從你另一個指定角色身上移除至多 2 點傷害。以此方式每移除 1 點傷害就獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Rescue Rangers Away!

Count the number of characters you have in play.

name: Chief Bogo - Gazelle Fan

YOU LIKE GAZELLE TOO? While you have a
character named Gazelle in play, this character
gains Singer 6. (This character counts as cost 6 to
sing songs.)
zh: 你也喜歡 Gazelle？　當你有一個名為 Gazelle 的角色在場時，這個角色獲得歌手 6。（這個角色視為費用 6 來詠唱歌曲。）

name: Honey Lemon - Chemical Genius

HERE'S THE BEST PART When you play this
character, you may pay 2 ⬡ to have each
opponent choose and discard a card.
zh: 這是最棒的部分　當你打出這個角色時，你可以支付 2 ⬡ 讓每位對手選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: Chip - Ranger Leader
en:

character named Dale in play, this character gains
Support. (Whenever they quest, you may add their
¤ to another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
zh: 友誼的價值　當你有一個名為 Dale 的角色在場時，這個角色獲得支援。（每當他們探險時，你可以在本回合把其 ¤ 加到另一個指定角色的 ¤ 上。）

name: Minnie Mouse - Pirate Lookout
en:
LAND, HO! Once during your turn, whenever a
card is put into your inkwell, you may return a
location card from your discard to your hand.

BLADES OF FURY When you play this character, you
may banish chosen item. Its player gains 1 lore.
QUICK REFLEXES During your turn, this character
gains Evasive. (They can challenge characters with
Evasive.)
zh:
狂怒之刃　當你打出這個角色時，你可以消滅指定的物品。其持有者獲得 1 點傳說值。
快速反應　在你的回合中，這個角色獲得迴避。（他們可以挑戰具迴避的角色。）

Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Mickey Mouse.)
MARINER'S MIGHT Whenever this character

變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Mickey Mouse 的角色上。）

變身 5（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Chip 或 Dale 的角色上。）
（這個角色同時視為名為 Chip 和 Dale。）

name: Roo - Littlest Pirate

I'M A PIRATE TOO! When you play this character,
you may give chosen character -2 ¤ until the
start of your next turn.
zh: 我也是海盜！　當你打出這個角色時，你可以給予指定角色 -2 ¤，直到你的下個回合開始。

name: Mr. Litwak - Arcade Owner

THE GANG'S ALL HERE Once during your turn,
whenever you play another character, you may
ready this character. He can't quest or challenge
for the rest of this turn.
zh: 大伙都到齊了　你回合中一次，每當你打出另一個角色時，你可以準備這個角色。他本回合剩餘時間內不能探險或挑戰。

Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.

MAKE A RESCUE ⟳, 3 ⬡ — Return a Pirate character

I MADE HER ⟳ one of your characters — Chosen

Dragon character card, put it into your hand and
repeat this effect. Otherwise, put it on either the
top or the bottom of your deck.
zh: 信任建立信任　每當這個角色探險時，展示你牌庫頂的卡。若它是龍角色卡，將它加入手牌並重複此效果；否則，將它放到你牌庫頂或牌庫底。

name: Madam Mim - Truly Marvelous
en:
OH, BAT GIZZARDS 2 ⬡, Choose and discard a
card — Gain 1 lore.
zh: 喔，蝙蝠內臟　2 ⬡，選擇並棄掉一張卡 — 獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Yzma - Conniving Chemist
en:
FEEL THE POWER ⟳ — If you have fewer than 3
cards in your hand, draw until you have 3 cards in
your hand.
zh: 感受力量　⟳ — 若你手牌少於 3 張，抽牌直到你手牌有 3 張。

name: Mama Odie - Solitary Sage
en:
I'VE GOT TO DO EVERYTHING AROUND HERE

2 damage counters from chosen character to
chosen opposing character.
zh: 這裡所有事都得我來做　每當你打出一首歌時，你可以將至多 2 個傷害指示物從指定角色移到指定的對方角色。

name: Peter Pan - Shadow Catcher
en:
GOTCHA! During your turn, whenever a card
is put into your inkwell, exert chosen opposing
character.
zh: 逮到了！　在你的回合中，每當有卡被放入你的墨水池時，橫置指定的對方角色。

name: Mad Hatter - Eccentric Host
en:
WE'LL HAVE TO LOOK INTO THIS Whenever this
character quests, you may look at the top card of
chosen player's deck. Put it on top of their deck
or into their discard.
zh: 我們得查查這個　每當這個角色探險時，你可以查看指定玩家牌庫頂的卡。將它放到其牌庫頂或放入其棄牌堆。

name: A Very Merry Unbirthday
en:
(A character with cost 1 or more can ⟳ to sing this song for free.)
Each opponent puts the top 2 cards of their deck into their discard.
zh:
非常快樂的非生日　（費用 1 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
每位對手將其牌庫頂 2 張卡放入棄牌堆。

name: Genie - Wonderful Trickster
en:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Genie.)
YOUR REWARD AWAITS Whenever you play a card, draw a card.
FORBIDDEN TREASURE At the end of your turn, put all the
cards in your hand on the bottom of your deck in any order.
zh:
變身 5（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Genie 的角色上。）
你的獎賞在等待　每當你打出一張卡時，抽一張牌。
禁忌寶藏　在你的回合結束時，將你手牌中所有卡以任意順序放到你牌庫底。

name: Making Magic
en:
Move 1 damage counter from chosen character to
chosen opposing character. Draw a card.
zh: 將 1 個傷害指示物從指定角色移到指定的對方角色。抽一張牌。

name: Lose the Way
en:
Exert chosen character. Then, you may choose and
discard a card. If you do, the exerted character can't
ready at the start of their next turn.
zh: 橫置指定角色。然後，你可以選擇並棄掉一張卡。若你這麼做，該橫置角色在其下個回合開始時不能準備。

name: Seeking the Half Crown
en:
For each Sorcerer character you have in play, you pay 1 ⬡ less
to play this action.
Draw 2 cards.
zh:
你每有一個法師角色在場，你打出這個行動時就少支付 1 ⬡。
抽兩張牌。

name: Maleficent's Staff
en:
BACK, FOOLS! Whenever one of your opponents'
characters, items, or locations is returned to their hand
from play, gain 1 lore.
zh: 退下，蠢貨！　每當你一個對手的角色、物品或地點從場上被移回其手牌時，獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Mad Hatter's Teapot
en:
NO ROOM, NO ROOM ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Each opponent puts
the top card of their deck into their discard.
zh: 沒位子，沒位子　⟳，1 ⬡ — 每位對手將其牌庫頂的卡放入棄牌堆。

name: Pixie Dust
en:
FAITH AND TRUST ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Chosen character gains
Challenger +2 and Evasive until the start of your
next turn. (While challenging, they get +2 ¤. Only
characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
zh: 信念與信任　⟳，2 ⬡ — 指定角色獲得挑戰者 +2 和迴避，直到你的下個回合開始。（挑戰時，他們獲得 +2 ¤。只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。）

name: Mystical Tree - Mama Odie's Home
en:
NOT BAD At the start of your turn, you may move 1 damage counter from chosen
character here to chosen opposing character.
HARD-EARNED WISDOM At the start of your turn, if you have a character named Mama
Odie here, gain 1 lore.
zh:
還不錯　在你的回合開始時，你可以將 1 個傷害指示物從這裡的指定角色移到指定的對方角色。
得來不易的智慧　在你的回合開始時，若你這裡有一個名為 Mama Odie 的角色，獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Jasmine - Royal Seafarer
en:
BY ORDER OF THE PRINCESS When you play this
character, choose one:
• Exert chosen damaged character.
• Chosen opposing character gains Reckless
during their next turn. (They can't quest and must
challenge if able.)
zh:
奉公主之命　當你打出這個角色時，選擇一項：
• 橫置指定的受傷角色。
• 指定的對方角色在其下個回合獲得魯莽。（他們不能探險，且若有能力必須挑戰。）

name: Captain Hook - Underhanded
en:
INSPIRES DREAD While this character is exerted,
opposing Pirate characters can't quest.
UPPER HAND Whenever this character is
challenged, draw a card.
zh:
激起恐懼　當這個角色橫置時，對方的海盜角色不能探險。
占上風　每當這個角色被挑戰時，抽一張牌。

name: Stitch - Alien Buccaneer
en:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Stitch.)
READY FOR ACTION When you play this character,
if you used Shift to play him, you may put an action
card from your discard on the top of your deck.
zh:
變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Stitch 的角色上。）
準備行動　當你打出這個角色時，若你以變身打出他，你可以將一張行動卡從棄牌堆放到你牌庫頂。

name: Go Go Tomago - Darting Dynamo
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
STOP WHINING, WOMAN UP When you play this
character, you may pay 2 ⬡ to gain lore equal to
the damage on chosen opposing character.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
別抱怨了，振作起來　當你打出這個角色時，你可以支付 2 ⬡ 獲得等同指定對方角色身上傷害的傳說值。

name: Honey Lemon - Chemical Genius
en:
HERE'S THE BEST PART When you play this

opponent choose and discard a card.

name: Fred - Mascot by Day

HOW COOL IS THAT Whenever this character is

DISTANT SHORES Whenever one of your Pirate

RULER OF THE SEAS When you play this character,
if you used Shift to play her, return all other
exerted characters to their players' hands.
zh:
變身 5（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Jasmine 的角色上。）
海洋統治者　當你打出這個角色時，若你以變身打出她，將所有其他橫置的角色移回其持有者的手牌。

name: Peter Pan - Never Land Prankster

LOOK INNOCENT This character enters play exerted.
CAN'T TAKE A JOKE? While this character is exerted,

zh:
裝無辜　這個角色橫置進場。
開不起玩笑？　當這個角色橫置時，每位對手除非其一個角色本回合挑戰過，否則不能獲得傳說值。

name: Alistair Krei - Ambitious Entrepreneur

name: Prepare to Board!

name: You Came Back

name: MegaBot
en:
HAPPY FACE This item enters play exerted.
DESTROY! ⟳, Banish this item — Choose one:

• Banish chosen damaged character.
zh:
笑臉　這個物品橫置進場。
摧毀！　⟳，消滅這個物品 — 選擇一項：
• 消滅指定的物品。

name: Galactic Communicator

RESOURCE ALLOCATION 1 ⬡, Banish this item — Return
chosen character with 2 ¤ or less to their player's hand.

name: Transport Pod

GIVE 'EM A SHOW At the start of your turn, you may

name: Perilous Maze - Watery Labyrinth

LOST IN THE WAVES Whenever a character is challenged while here, each

zh: 迷失於浪濤　每當有角色在這裡被挑戰時，每位對手選擇並棄掉一張卡。

團隊合作　你這裡每有一個角色，你每回合打出的第一個行動就少支付 1 ⬡。

name: Mickey Mouse - Pirate Captain
en:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Mickey Mouse.)
MARINER'S MIGHT Whenever this character

challenges” this turn.
zh:
變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Mickey Mouse 的角色上。）

name: Kakamora - Boarding Party

Rush (This character can challenge the turn

DIZZYING SPEED When you play this character,
chosen Pirate character gains Evasive until the

Evasive can challenge them.)
zh: 令人暈眩的速度　當你打出這個角色時，指定的海盜角色獲得迴避，直到你的下個回合開始。（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。）

name: Jasmine - Rebellious Princess

YOU'LL NEVER MISS IT Whenever this character

zh: 你不會想念它　每當這個角色探險時，每位對手失去 1 點傳說值。

name: Raya - Kumandran Rider

COME ON, LET'S DO THIS Once during your turn,
whenever a card is put into your inkwell, you may
ready another chosen character of yours. They
can't quest for the rest of this turn.
zh: 來吧，我們動手　你回合中一次，每當有卡被放入你的墨水池時，你可以準備你另一個指定角色。他們本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

name: Wendy Darling - Courageous Captain
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
LOOK LIVELY, CREW! While you have another
Pirate character in play, this character gets +1 ¤
and +1 ◊.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
打起精神，船員！　當你另有一個海盜角色在場時，這個角色獲得 +1 ¤ 和 +1 ◊。

name: John Silver - Ferocious Friend

CHART YOUR OWN COURSE Whenever this
character quests, you may deal 1 damage to
another chosen character of yours. If you do,
ready that character. They can't quest for the rest
of this turn.
zh: 走自己的路　每當這個角色探險時，你可以對你另一個指定角色造成 1 點傷害。若你這麼做，準備該角色。他們本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

name: Vanellope von Schweetz - Gutsy Go-Getter
en:
AS READY AS I'LL EVER BE At the start of your turn,
if this character is at a location, draw a card and

zh: 我隨時準備好了　在你的回合開始時，若這個角色在地點，抽一張牌並獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Markowski - Space Trooper

變身 2（你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Aladdin 的角色上。）
記住你的訓練　當你打出這個角色時，你的角色本回合獲得 +2 ¤。

name: Minnie Mouse - Pirate Lookout

LAND, HO! Once during your turn, whenever a

zh: 陸地，看到了！　你回合中一次，每當有卡被放入你的墨水池時，你可以將一張地點卡從棄牌堆移回你的手牌。

name: Moana - Kakamora Leader
en:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Moana.)
GATHERING FORCES When you play this

zh:
變身 5（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Moana 的角色上。）

name: Goofy - Flying Goof

迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Thievery
en: Chosen opponent loses 1 lore. Gain 1 lore.
zh: 偷竊　指定對手失去 1 點傳說值。獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Lead the Way
en: Your characters get +2 ¤ this turn.
zh: 你的角色本回合獲得 +2 ¤。

name: The Islands I Pulled from the Sea
en:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this song
for free.)
Search your deck for a location card, reveal that card to all
players, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
zh:
（費用 3 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
在你的牌庫中搜尋一張地點卡並向所有玩家展示，然後加入手牌。然後，洗你的牌庫。

name: Energy Blast
en: Banish chosen character. Draw a card.
zh: 消滅指定角色。抽一張牌。

name: Longboat
en:
TAKE IT FOR A SPIN 2 ⬡ — Chosen character of yours
gains Evasive until the start of your next turn. (Only
characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
zh: 兜個風　2 ⬡ — 你一個指定角色獲得迴避，直到你的下個回合開始。（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。）

name: Gold Coin
en:
SPARKLY ACCESS ⟳, 1 ⬡, Banish this item — Ready
chosen character of yours. They can't quest for the
rest of this turn.
zh: 閃亮通行　⟳，1 ⬡，消滅這個物品 — 準備你一個指定角色。他們本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

name: Card Soldier's Spear
en: A SUITABLE WEAPON Your damaged characters get +1 ¤.
zh: 合適的武器　你的受傷角色獲得 +1 ¤。

name: Flotilla - Coconut Armada
en:
TINY THIEVES At the start of your turn, if you have a character here,
all opponents lose 1 lore and you gain lore equal to the lore lost this way.
zh: 小小盜賊　在你的回合開始時，若你這裡有一個角色，所有對手失去 1 點傳說值，你獲得等同以此方式失去的傳說值。

name: Skull Rock - Isolated Fortress
en:
FAMILIAR GROUND Characters get +1 ¤ while here.
SAFE HAVEN At the start of your turn, if you have a Pirate character
here, gain 1 lore.
zh:
熟悉的領域　角色在這裡時獲得 +1 ¤。
避風港　在你的回合開始時，若你這裡有一個海盜角色，獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: B.E.N. - Eccentric Robot
en:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)
zh: 支援（每當這個角色探險時，你可以在本回合把其 ¤ 加到另一個指定角色的 ¤ 上。）

name: Aunt Cass - Biggest Fan
en:
HAPPY TO HELP Whenever this character quests,
chosen Inventor character gets +1 ◊ this turn.
zh: 樂於幫忙　每當這個角色探險時，指定的發明家角色本回合獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Gadget Hackwrench - Creative Thinker
en:
BRAINSTORM Whenever you play an item, this
character gets +1 ◊ this turn.
zh: 腦力激盪　每當你打出一個物品時，這個角色本回合獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Gadget Hackwrench - Brilliant Bosun
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on
top of one of your characters named Gadget
Hackwrench.)
MECHANICALLY SAVVY While you have 3 or more
items in play, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play Inventor
characters.
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Gadget Hackwrench 的角色上。）
機械通　當你有 3 個或以上的物品在場時，你打出發明家角色時少支付 1 ⬡。

name: Zipper - Astute Decoy
en:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
RUN INTERFERENCE During your turn, whenever
a card is put into your inkwell, another chosen
character gains Resist +1 until the start of your
next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
zh:
守護（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇這個角色。）
干擾　在你的回合中，每當有卡被放入你的墨水池時，另一個指定角色獲得抵抗 +1，直到你的下個回合開始。（對他們造成的傷害減少 1。）

name: Oswald - The Lucky Rabbit
en:
FAVORABLE CHANCE During your turn, whenever
a card is put into your inkwell, you may reveal the
top card of your deck. If it's an item card, you may
play that item for free and it enters play exerted.
Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.
zh: 有利機會　在你的回合中，每當有卡被放入你的墨水池時，你可以展示你牌庫頂的卡。若它是物品卡，你可以免費打出該物品且它橫置進場；否則，將它放到你牌庫底。

name: Yokai - Enigmatic Inventor
en:
TIME TO UPGRADE Whenever this character
quests, you may return one of your items to your
hand to pay 2 ⬡ less for the next item you play
this turn.
zh: 該升級了　每當這個角色探險時，你可以將你一個物品移回你的手牌，來使你本回合打出的下一個物品少支付 2 ⬡。

name: Pleakley - Scientific Expert
en:
REPORTING FOR DUTY When you play this
character, put chosen character of yours into your
inkwell facedown and exerted.
zh: 前來報到　當你打出這個角色時，將你一個指定角色牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: Hiro Hamada - Robotics Prodigy
en:
SWEET TECH ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Search your deck for an item
card or a Robot character card and reveal it to all
players. Shuffle your deck and put that card on top of it.
zh: 厲害的科技　⟳，2 ⬡ — 在你的牌庫中搜尋一張物品卡或機器人角色卡並向所有玩家展示。洗你的牌庫並將該卡放到牌庫頂。

name: HeiHei - Not-So-Tricky Chicken
en:
EAT ANYTHING When you play this character,
exert chosen opposing item. It can't ready at the
start of its next turn.
OUT TO LUNCH During your turn, this character
gains Evasive. (They can challenge characters
with Evasive.)
zh:
什麼都吃　當你打出這個角色時，橫置指定的對方物品。它在其下個回合開始時不能準備。
外出吃飯　在你的回合中，這個角色獲得迴避。（他們可以挑戰具迴避的角色。）

name: Sour Bill - Surly Henchman
en:
UNPALATABLE When you play this character,
chosen opposing character gets -2 ¤ this turn.
zh: 難以下嚥　當你打出這個角色時，指定的對方角色本回合獲得 -2 ¤。

name: Nick Wilde - Soggy Fox
en:
NICE TO HAVE A PARTNER While you have another
character with Support in play, this character gets
+2 ¤.
zh: 有個搭檔真好　當你另有一個具支援的角色在場時，這個角色獲得 +2 ¤。

name: Wasabi - Methodical Engineer
en:
BLADES OF FURY When you play this character, you
may banish chosen item. Its player gains 1 lore.
QUICK REFLEXES During your turn, this character
gains Evasive. (They can challenge characters with
Evasive.)
zh:
狂怒之刃　當你打出這個角色時，你可以消滅指定的物品。其持有者獲得 1 點傳說值。
快速反應　在你的回合中，這個角色獲得迴避。（他們可以挑戰具迴避的角色。）

name: Nick Wilde - Sly Fox
en:
Shift 1 (You may pay 1 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Nick Wilde.)
YOU CAN'T TOUCH ME While you have an item in
play, this character can't be challenged.
zh:
變身 1（你可以支付 1 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Nick Wilde 的角色上。）
你碰不到我　當你有一個物品在場時，這個角色不能被挑戰。

name: Tadashi Hamada - Baymax Inventor
en:
LET'S GET BACK TO WORK This character gets +1 ¤
and +1 ⛉ for each item you have in play.
zh: 回去工作吧　你每有一個物品在場，這個角色就獲得 +1 ¤ 和 +1 ⛉。

name: Hiro Hamada - Team Leader
en:
I NEED TO UPGRADE ALL OF YOU Your other
Inventor characters gain Resist +1. (Damage dealt
to them is reduced by 1.)
SHAPE THE FUTURE 2 ⬡ — Look at the top card of
your deck. Put it on either the top or the bottom
of your deck.
zh:
我得升級你們全部　你其他的發明家角色獲得抵抗 +1。（對他們造成的傷害減少 1。）
形塑未來　2 ⬡ — 查看你牌庫頂的卡。將它放到你牌庫頂或牌庫底。

name: Tadashi Hamada - Gifted Roboticist
en:
SOMEONE HAS TO HELP During an opponent's turn,
when this character is banished, you may put the top
card of your deck into your inkwell facedown. Then, put
this card into your inkwell facedown.
zh: 總得有人幫忙　在對手的回合中，當這個角色被消滅時，你可以將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下放入你的墨水池。然後，將這張卡牌面朝下放入你的墨水池。

name: Baymax - Personal Healthcare Companion
en:
FULLY CHARGED If you have an Inventor character
in play, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this character.
YOU SAID ‘OW’ 2 ⬡ — Remove up to 1 damage
from another chosen character.
zh:
充飽電　若你有一個發明家角色在場，你打出這個角色時少支付 1 ⬡。
你說「哎喲」　2 ⬡ — 從另一個指定角色身上移除至多 1 點傷害。

name: Baymax - Armored Companion
en:
THE TREATMENT IS WORKING When you play
this character and whenever he quests, you may
remove up to 2 damage from another chosen
character of yours. Gain 1 lore for each 1 damage
removed this way.
zh: 治療起效了　當你打出這個角色以及每當他探險時，你可以從你另一個指定角色身上移除至多 2 點傷害。以此方式每移除 1 點傷害就獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Yokai - Scientific Supervillain
en:
Shift 6 (You may pay 6 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Yokai.)
NEUROTRANSMITTER You may play items named
Microbots for free.
TECHNICAL GAIN Whenever this character quests,
draw a card for each opposing character with 0 ¤.
zh:
變身 6（你可以支付 6 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Yokai 的角色上。）
神經傳導器　你可以免費打出名為 Microbots 的物品。
技術獲益　每當這個角色探險時，你每有一個 0 ¤ 的對方角色就抽一張牌。

name: Alice - Savvy Sailor
en:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
AHOY! Whenever this character quests, another
chosen character of yours gets +1 ◊ and gains
Ward until the start of your next turn.
zh:
守護（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇這個角色。）
啊嗨！　每當這個角色探險時，你另一個指定角色獲得 +1 ◊ 並獲得守護，直到你的下個回合開始。

name: We Could Be Immortals
en:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Your Inventor characters gain Resist +6 this turn. Then,
put this card into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
(Damage dealt to them is reduced by 6.)
zh:
（費用 4 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
你的發明家角色本回合獲得抵抗 +6。然後，將這張卡牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。（對他們造成的傷害減少 6。）

name: Sail the Azurite Sea
en: This turn, you may ink an additional card. Draw a card.
zh: 本回合你可以額外將一張卡放入墨水池。抽一張牌。

name: Helping Hand
en:
Chosen character gains Support this turn. Draw a card.
(Whenever they quest, you may add their ¤ to another
chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
zh: 指定角色本回合獲得支援。抽一張牌。（每當他們探險時，你可以在本回合把其 ¤ 加到另一個指定角色的 ¤ 上。）

name: Prepare Your Bot
en:
Choose one:
• Ready chosen item.
• Ready chosen Robot character. They can't quest for
the rest of this turn.
zh:
選擇一項：
• 準備指定的物品。
• 準備指定的機器人角色。他們本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

name: Baymax's Healthcare Chip
en:
10,000 MEDICAL PROCEDURES ⟳ — Choose one:
• Remove up to 1 damage from chosen character.
• If you have a Robot character in play, remove up to 3
damage from chosen character.
zh:
一萬種醫療程序　⟳ — 選擇一項：
• 從指定角色身上移除至多 1 點傷害。
• 若你有一個機器人角色在場，從指定角色身上移除至多 3 點傷害。

name: Microbots
en:
LIMITLESS APPLICATIONS You may have any number of
cards named Microbots in your deck.
INSPIRED TECH When you play this item, chosen
character gets -1 ¤ this turn for each item named
Microbots you have in play.
zh:
無限應用　你的牌庫中可以放入任意數量名為 Microbots 的卡。
啟發科技　當你打出這個物品時，你每有一個名為 Microbots 的物品在場，指定角色本回合就獲得 -1 ¤。

name: Jumbo Pop
en:
HERE YOU GO Banish this item — Remove up to 2
damage from each of your characters. Draw a card.
zh: 拿去吧　消滅這個物品 — 從你每個角色身上移除至多 2 點傷害。抽一張牌。

name: Rescue Rangers Submarine - Mobile Headquarters
en:
PLANNING SESSION At the start of your turn, if you have a character
here, you may put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown
and exerted.
zh: 規劃會議　在你的回合開始時，若你這裡有一個角色，你可以將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: Institute of Technology - Prestigious University
en:
WELCOME TO THE LAB Inventor characters get +1 ⛉ while here.
PUSH THE BOUNDARIES At the start of your turn, if you have a character
here, gain 1 lore.
zh:
歡迎來到實驗室　發明家角色在這裡時獲得 +1 ⛉。
突破界限　在你的回合開始時，若你這裡有一個角色，獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Kakamora - Long-Range Specialist
en:
A LITTLE HELP When you play this character, if you
have another Pirate character in play, you may deal 1
damage to chosen character or location.
zh: 一點幫助　當你打出這個角色時，若你另有一個海盜角色在場，你可以對指定角色或地點造成 1 點傷害。

name: Kakamora - Pirate Chief
en:
HEAD COCONUT Whenever this character quests,
you may draw a card, then choose and discard
a card to deal 1 damage to chosen character or
location. If you discarded a Pirate character card,
deal 3 damage instead.
zh: 椰子頭目　每當這個角色探險時，你可以抽一張牌，然後選擇並棄掉一張卡，來對指定角色或地點造成 1 點傷害。若你棄掉一張海盜角色卡，改為造成 3 點傷害。

name: Jim Hawkins - Stubborn Cabin Boy
en:
COME ON, COME ON, COME ON! During your turn,
whenever a card is put into your inkwell, this
character gains Challenger +2 this turn. (They get
+2 ¤ while challenging.)
zh: 快點，快點，快點！　在你的回合中，每當有卡被放入你的墨水池時，這個角色本回合獲得挑戰者 +2。（他們挑戰時獲得 +2 ¤。）

name: Mr. Big - Shrewd Tycoon
en:
REPUTATION This character can't be challenged
by characters with 2 ¤ or greater.
zh: 名聲　這個角色不能被 2 ¤ 或以上的角色挑戰。

name: Mr. Smee - Steadfast Mate
en:
GOOD CATCH During your turn, this character
gains Evasive. (They can challenge characters
with Evasive.)
zh: 好接應　在你的回合中，這個角色獲得迴避。（他們可以挑戰具迴避的角色。）

name: Mr. Smee - Captain of the Jolly Roger
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Mr. Smee.)
RAISE THE COLORS When you play this character,
you may deal damage to chosen character equal to
the number of your other Pirate characters in play.
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Mr. Smee 的角色上。）
升起旗幟　當你打出這個角色時，你可以對指定角色造成等同你其他海盜角色數量的傷害。

name: Mullins - Seasoned Shipmate
en:
FALL IN LINE While you have a character named
Mr. Smee in play, this character gains Resist +1.
(Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
zh: 排好隊　當你有一個名為 Mr. Smee 的角色在場時，這個角色獲得抵抗 +1。（對他們造成的傷害減少 1。）

name: Hercules - Unwavering Demigod
en:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character
gets +2 ¤.)
zh: 挑戰者 +2（挑戰時，這個角色獲得 +2 ¤。）

name: John Silver - Ship's Cook
en:
HUNK OF HARDWARE When you play this
character, chosen character can't challenge
during their next turn.
zh: 一堆廢鐵　當你打出這個角色時，指定角色在其下個回合不能挑戰。

name: Mr. Arrow - Legacy's First Mate
en:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
zh: 抵抗 +1（這個角色受到的傷害減少 1。）

name: Jim Hawkins - Rigging Specialist
en:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Jim Hawkins.)
BATTLE STATIONS When you play this character,
you may deal 1 damage to chosen character or
location.
zh:
變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Jim Hawkins 的角色上。）
戰鬥崗位　當你打出這個角色時，你可以對指定角色或地點造成 1 點傷害。

name: Billy Bones - Space Sailor
en:
KEEP IT HIDDEN When this character is banished,
you may banish chosen item or location.
zh: 藏好它　當這個角色被消滅時，你可以消滅指定的物品或地點。

name: Pluto - Guard Dog
en:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)
GOOD BOY While this character has no damage,
he gets +4 ¤.
zh:
護衛（這個角色可以橫置進場。挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）
好狗狗　當這個角色沒有傷害時，他獲得 +4 ¤。

name: Mickey Mouse - Night Watch
en:
BACKUP Your characters named Pluto gain
Resist +1. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
zh: 後援　你名為 Pluto 的角色獲得抵抗 +1。（對他們造成的傷害減少 1。）

name: Cobra Bubbles - Former CIA
en:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)
THINK ABOUT WHAT'S BEST 2 ⬡ — Draw a card,
then choose and discard a card.
zh:
護衛（這個角色可以橫置進場。挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）
想想什麼最好　2 ⬡ — 抽一張牌，然後選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: Wreck-It Ralph - Ham Hands
en:
I WRECK THINGS Whenever this character quests, you
may banish chosen item or location to gain 2 lore.
zh: 我破壞東西　每當這個角色探險時，你可以消滅指定的物品或地點，來獲得 2 點傳說值。

name: Calhoun - Marine Sergeant
en:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
LEVEL UP During your turn, whenever this
character banishes another character in a
challenge, gain 2 lore.
zh:
抵抗 +1（這個角色受到的傷害減少 1。）
升級　在你的回合中，每當這個角色在挑戰中消滅另一個角色時，獲得 2 點傳說值。

name: Captain Amelia - Commander of the Legacy
en:
DRIVELING GALOOTS This character can't be
challenged by Pirate characters.
EVERYTHING SHIPSHAPE While being challenged,
your other characters gain Resist +1. (Damage
dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
zh:
胡言亂語的笨蛋　這個角色不能被海盜角色挑戰。
一切井然有序　被挑戰時，你其他的角色獲得抵抗 +1。（對他們造成的傷害減少 1。）

name: Jafar - Power-Hungry Vizier
en:
YOU'LL GET WHAT'S COMING TO YOU During your turn,
whenever a card is put into your inkwell, deal 1 damage
to chosen character.
zh: 你會得到報應的　在你的回合中，每當有卡被放入你的墨水池時，對指定角色造成 1 點傷害。

name: John Silver - Stern Captain
en:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named John Silver.)
Resist +2 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 2.)
DON'T JUST SIT THERE! At the start of your turn, deal 1
damage to each opposing ready character.
zh:
變身 5（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 John Silver 的角色上。）
抵抗 +2（這個角色受到的傷害減少 2。）
別只是坐在那裡！　在你的回合開始時，對每個對方的已準備角色造成 1 點傷害。

name: Hot Potato
en:
Choose one:
• Deal 2 damage to chosen character.
• Banish chosen item.
zh:
選擇一項：
• 對指定角色造成 2 點傷害。
• 消滅指定的物品。

name: I'm Still Here
en:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Chosen character gains Resist +2 until the start of
your next turn. Draw a card. (Damage dealt to them is
reduced by 2.)
zh:
（費用 3 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
指定角色獲得抵抗 +2，直到你的下個回合開始。抽一張牌。（對他們造成的傷害減少 2。）

name: Twin Fire
en:
Deal 2 damage to chosen character. Then, you may
choose and discard a card to deal 2 damage to another
chosen character.
zh: 對指定角色造成 2 點傷害。然後，你可以選擇並棄掉一張卡，來對另一個指定角色造成 2 點傷害。

name: Ambush!
en:
⟳ one of your characters to deal damage equal to
their ¤ to chosen character.
zh: 橫置你一個角色，來對指定角色造成等同其 ¤ 的傷害。

name: Unfortunate Situation
en:
Each opponent chooses one of their characters and
deals 4 damage to them.
zh: 每位對手選擇其一個角色並對其造成 4 點傷害。

name: King's Sensor Core
en:
SYMBOL OF ROYALTY Your Prince and King characters
gain Resist +1. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
ROYAL SEARCH ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Reveal the top card of your
deck. If it's a Prince or King character card, you may
put that card into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the
top of your deck.
zh:
皇室象徵　你的王子和國王角色獲得抵抗 +1。（對他們造成的傷害減少 1。）
皇家搜尋　⟳，2 ⬡ — 展示你牌庫頂的卡。若它是王子或國王角色卡，你可以將它加入手牌；否則，將它放到你牌庫頂。

name: Training Dummy
en:
HANDLE WITH CARE ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Chosen character
gains Bodyguard until the start of your next turn.
(An opposing character who challenges one of your
characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
zh: 小心處理　⟳，2 ⬡ — 指定角色獲得護衛，直到你的下個回合開始。（挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）

name: Sunglasses
en:
SPYCRAFT ⟳ — Draw a card, then choose and discard
a card.
zh: 間諜技術　⟳ — 抽一張牌，然後選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: Treasure Mountain - Azurite Sea Island
en:
SECRET WEAPON At the start of your turn, deal damage to chosen
character or location equal to the number of characters here.
zh: 秘密武器　在你的回合開始時，對指定角色或地點造成等同這裡角色數量的傷害。

name: Galactic Council Chamber - Courtroom
en:
FEDERATION DECREE While you have an Alien or Robot character here,
this location can't be challenged.
zh: 聯邦法令　當你這裡有一個 Alien 或機器人角色時，這個地點不能被挑戰。

name: Chip 'n' Dale - Recovery Rangers
en:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Chip or Dale.)
(This character counts as being named both Chip and Dale.)
SEARCH AND RESCUE During your turn, whenever a card
is put into your inkwell, you may return a character card
from your discard to your hand.
zh:
變身 5（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Chip 或 Dale 的角色上。）
（這個角色同時視為名為 Chip 和 Dale。）
搜救　在你的回合中，每當有卡被放入你的墨水池時，你可以將一張角色卡從棄牌堆移回你的手牌。

name: Tiana - Restaurant Owner
en:
SPECIAL RESERVATION Whenever a character
of yours is challenged while this character is
exerted, the challenging character gets -3 ¤
this turn unless their player pays 3 ⬡.
zh: 特別預約　當這個角色橫置時，每當你一個角色被挑戰時，除非進行挑戰的角色的玩家支付 3 ⬡，否則該角色本回合獲得 -3 ¤。

name: Sugar Rush Speedway - Finish Line
en:
BRING IT HOME, KID! When you move a character here from a
location, you may banish this location to gain 3 lore and draw 3 cards.
zh: 衝回終點，孩子！　當你把一個角色從一個地點移動到這裡時，你可以消滅這個地點，來獲得 3 點傳說值並抽 3 張牌。

name: Rafiki - Ethereal Guide
en:
Shift 7 (You may pay 7 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Rafiki.)
ASTRAL ATTUNEMENT During your turn,
whenever a card is put into your inkwell, you
may draw a card.
zh:
變身 7（你可以支付 7 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Rafiki 的角色上。）
星界共鳴　在你的回合中，每當有卡被放入你的墨水池時，你可以抽一張牌。

name: Yzma - Conniving Chemist
en:
FEEL THE POWER ⟳ — If you have fewer than
3 cards in your hand, draw until you have 3
cards in your hand.
zh: 感受力量　⟳ — 若你手牌少於 3 張，抽牌直到你手牌有 3 張。

name: Maleficent's Staff
en:
BACK, FOOLS! Whenever one of your opponents'
characters, items, or locations is returned to their
hand from play, gain 1 lore.
zh: 退下，蠢貨！　每當你一個對手的角色、物品或地點從場上被移回其手牌時，獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Daisy Duck - Pirate Captain
en:
DISTANT SHORES Whenever one of your
Pirate characters quests while at a location,
draw a card.
zh: 遙遠的海岸　每當你一個海盜角色在地點探險時，抽一張牌。

name: Basil - Disguised Detective
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Basil.)
TWISTS AND TURNS During your turn, whenever a
card is put into your inkwell, you may pay 1 ⬡ to
have chosen opponent choose and discard a card.
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Basil 的角色上。）
峰迴路轉　在你的回合中，每當有卡被放入你的墨水池時，你可以支付 1 ⬡ 讓指定對手選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: You Came Back
en: Ready chosen character.
zh: 準備指定角色。

name: Raya - Kumandran Rider
en:
COME ON, LET'S DO THIS Once during your
turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell,
you may ready another chosen character of
yours. They can't quest for the rest of this turn.
zh: 來吧，我們動手　你回合中一次，每當有卡被放入你的墨水池時，你可以準備你另一個指定角色。他們本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

name: Tigger - In the Crow's Nest
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
SWASH YOUR BUCKLES Whenever you play an
action, this character gets +1 ¤ and +1 ◊ this
turn.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
揮舞你的劍　每當你打出一個行動時，這個角色本回合獲得 +1 ¤ 和 +1 ◊。

name: The Islands I Pulled From the Sea
en:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Search your deck for a location card, reveal that
card to all players, and put it into your hand. Then,
shuffle your deck.
zh:
（費用 3 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
在你的牌庫中搜尋一張地點卡並向所有玩家展示，然後加入手牌。然後，洗你的牌庫。

name: Gadget Hackwrench - Brilliant Bosun
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on
top of one of your characters named Gadget
Hackwrench.)
MECHANICALLY SAVVY While you have 3 or more
items in play, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play Inventor
characters.
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Gadget Hackwrench 的角色上。）
機械通　當你有 3 個或以上的物品在場時，你打出發明家角色時少支付 1 ⬡。

name: Baymax - Personal Healthcare Companion
en:
FULLY CHARGED If you have an Inventor
character in play, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this
character.
YOU SAID ‘OW’ 2 ⬡ — Remove up to 1 damage
from another chosen character.
zh:
充飽電　若你有一個發明家角色在場，你打出這個角色時少支付 1 ⬡。
你說「哎喲」　2 ⬡ — 從另一個指定角色身上移除至多 1 點傷害。

name: We Could Be Immortals
en:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Your Inventor characters gain Resist +6 this turn.
Then, put this card into your inkwell facedown and
exerted. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 6.)
zh:
（費用 4 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
你的發明家角色本回合獲得抵抗 +6。然後，將這張卡牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。（對他們造成的傷害減少 6。）

name: Wreck-It Ralph - Ham Hands
en:
I WRECK THINGS Whenever this character
quests, you may banish chosen item or
location to gain 2 lore.
zh: 我破壞東西　每當這個角色探險時，你可以消滅指定的物品或地點，來獲得 2 點傳說值。

name: Captain Amelia - Commander of the Legacy
en:
DRIVELING GALOOTS This character can't be
challenged by Pirate characters.
EVERYTHING SHIPSHAPE While being
challenged, your other characters gain Resist +1.
(Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
zh:
胡言亂語的笨蛋　這個角色不能被海盜角色挑戰。
一切井然有序　被挑戰時，你其他的角色獲得抵抗 +1。（對他們造成的傷害減少 1。）

name: Treasure Mountain - Azurite Sea Island
en:
SECRET WEAPON At the start of your turn, deal damage to chosen
character or location equal to the number of characters here.
zh: 秘密武器　在你的回合開始時，對指定角色或地點造成等同這裡角色數量的傷害。
